name: flip
description: FlagOS #6620. OpenCV CUDA reference opencv_contrib@b67a855188a3d683813731010f6d39ac614733a4/modules/cudaarithm/src/core.cpp. Reverse rows if flip_code is zero, columns if it is positive, and both if it is negative.
